pairs.question: Who hit fewer career home runs?
pairs.fact: Pujols hit his 700th home run in September 2022, in his final season.

pairs.question: Which element was discovered first?
pairs.fact: Hennig Brand discovered phosphorus in 1669 while boiling down urine, looking for gold.

pairs.question: Which country has less coastline?
pairs.fact: Canada has the longest coastline in the world, more than 200,000 km including its islands.

pairs.question: Which animal is pregnant longer?
pairs.fact: Elephants are pregnant for about 22 months, the longest of any land animal.

pairs.question: Which city gets less rain each year?
pairs.fact: Hilo, Hawaii averages about 120 inches of rain a year, wetter than any big mainland US city.

pairs.question: Who scored more career NBA points?
pairs.fact: LeBron James became the first player to pass 40,000 regular-season points in 2024.

pairs.question: Which Broadway show ran for more performances?
pairs.fact: The Phantom of the Opera played 13,981 performances over 35 years, the longest run in Broadway history.

pairs.question: Which college has more undergraduates?
pairs.fact: Texas A&M has more undergraduates than any other US campus, over 50,000.

pairs.question: Which airport is busier?
pairs.fact: Atlanta has been the world's busiest airport by passengers almost every year since 1998.

pairs.question: Which LEGO set has fewer pieces?
pairs.fact: The 2022 LEGO Eiffel Tower has 10,001 pieces and stands almost 5 feet tall.
